newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures fall steeply into close.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures fall steeply into close.

text.p: July 18 - Sept S&P 500 stock index futures tumbled into the close and forged a new low in the final minutes, bottoming at 916.00. The contract ended with a loss of almost 20.0 points on the day. Dow off 130 points at 7890. S&P traders tied the weakness to profit-taking, retrenchment in technology issues - especially Microsoft - and selling related to options expiry.
